from_quote: My last address contained the outlines of a system fully adequate to all the useful purposes of the union
rationale: The writer refers to his last address, which set out his proposed system; Agrippa 10 (Massachusetts Gazette, January 1, 1788) is the preceding paper and ends with that proposal in the form of a resolve. This paper is dated January 8, 1788.

from_quote: give those members a right to sit six, or even two years
rationale: The paragraph names a six-year term of members under the new system; the six-year term of senators is set in Article I, Section 3, clause 1.
